1. (Currently Amended) A dynamic laminar structure, for example for working tools and machines, comprising a lamination of at least two layers and an internal layer, wherein the internal layer is a combination of two or more components, __wherein the lamination further comprises a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, the lamination comprising first and second outer layers, a first adhesive layer positioned adjacent the first outer layer, a second adhesive layer positioned adjacent the second outer layer, the internal layer positioned between the first and second adhesive layers, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the internal layer and the first outer layer and the second outer layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer respectively__.

2. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the internal layer comprises a metal.

3. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

4. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the internal layer is a composite material.

5. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 281 further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second outer layers.

6. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the internal layer.

7. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 285 wherein the laminar structure has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

8. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 287 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

9. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 281 further comprising an inner ring, wherein the internal layer is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

10. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

11. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 281 further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second outer layers and a plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

12. (Currently Amended) The laminar structure of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is segmented.
